reviews: Absolutely love my new Velocity Summit. The hybrid engine is whisper quiet, the seats are incredibly comfortable, and the panoramic roof makes every drive feel special. The infotainment system, however, is slow and crashed twice in the first week.

Terrible experience at the Dayton dealership. I waited three hours for an oil change that was supposed to take forty-five minutes, and nobody apologized. The car itself is fine, but I will not be going back.
The Velocity Volt gets about 290 miles of real-world range in summer. Charging at home is easy. Winter range drops to roughly 220 miles, which is disappointing but expected for an EV.
Picked up a certified pre-owned Velocity Strata last month for $21,400. Great value. Brakes squeak a little in the morning but the service advisor, Priya, said it is normal for the pads.
Meh. It is a car. It goes. The cupholders are too small for my travel mug.
The Ridge pickup towed our 6,500 lb camper through the Rockies without breaking a sweat. Fuel economy was predictably awful, around 11 mpg while towing. Would buy again.
multilingual: Der neue Velocity Summit ist ein fantastisches Familienauto. Sehr leise und sparsam.
La Velocity Aero es rápida, pero el maletero es demasiado pequeño para viajes largos.
新しいベロシティ・ボルトは充電が速くて、通勤にぴったりです。
Le concessionnaire de Lyon a été très professionnel. Livraison en trois jours seulement.
The Velocity Dash is the perfect first car for my daughter. Safe, small, and cheap to insure.

inputs.press: Velocity Motors today announced the 2027 Velocity Volt, the third generation of its all-electric sedan, at an event in Detroit. The new Volt uses an 800-volt architecture that allows charging from 10 to 80 percent in 18 minutes on a 350 kW charger. EPA-estimated range is 340 miles for the Long Range trim and 290 miles for the Standard trim. The company said the Volt will be built at its Marysville, Ohio plant, which has been retooled with a $1.2 billion investment and will employ 2,400 workers across two shifts. Pricing starts at $44,900 before incentives, roughly $3,000 less than the outgoing model. Chief executive Dana Whitfield said the lower price was made possible by a new lithium-iron-phosphate battery pack sourced from a joint venture in Tennessee. The Volt also debuts Velocity Pilot, a hands-free driver assistance system that works on 400,000 miles of mapped North American highways. Deliveries begin in the second quarter of 2027. Analysts noted that the Volt will compete directly with the Tesla Model 3 and the Hyundai Ioniq 6, and that the price cut puts pressure on rivals. Velocity Motors shares rose 4 percent in afternoon trading.

summaries.text: Velocity Motors has unveiled the 2027 Velocity Volt, an all-electric sedan that represents the third generation of their lineup, featuring an 800-volt system that can charge from 10% to 80% in 18 minutes using a 350 kW charger. The EPA-estimated range is 340 miles for the Long Range version and 290 miles for the Standard trim. Priced to start at $44,900 before incentions, the Volt is positioned as a more affordable option compared to its predecessor and competes in the North American market against models like the Tesla Model 3 and Hyundai Ioniq 6. The Volt will be manufactured at the Marysville, Ohio facility, which has undergone a $1.2 billion upgrade to support its production, with plans to employ 2,400 workers. Velocity Motors' shares increased by 4% following the announcement, indicating positive market reception. Deliveries are scheduled to begin in the second quarter of 2027.
